title: Library

deleteLibrary.confirmDescEmpty: This permanently deletes the library "{{name}}". This action cannot be undone.

add.label: Scan for new files
add.desc: Discover and register new media files, then scrape pending ones

remove.label: Remove dead entries
remove.desc: Delete records for files that no longer exist on disk

scrapeOverride.title: Scrape with number
scrapeOverride.contentTypeHint: Leave empty to infer from the number you enter.

batch.confirmDeleteDesc: Are you sure you want to delete {{count}} selected media files? This action cannot be undone.
batch.confirmDeleteDesc_one: Are you sure you want to delete {{count}} selected media file? This action cannot be undone.
batch.confirmDeleteDesc_other: Are you sure you want to delete {{count}} selected media files? This action cannot be undone.

detail.confirmDeleteDesc: Are you sure you want to delete this media file? This action cannot be undone.

automation.label: Automation
automation.hint: Watching and auto-scrape; organize stays manual

fieldTrailerPatternHint: Matches are treated as trailers and skipped during scan and watch
fieldBlacklistPatternsHint: One regex per line; matches are treated as junk, skipped during scan, moved to .amane_trash on organize
fieldMinFileSizeHint: Videos smaller than this are treated as junk and moved to .amane_trash on organize
fieldVideoTemplateHint: Relative or absolute path; see placeholder badges below
fieldLinkTemplateHint: Organize creates a strm/symlink here. Must be an absolute path outside the library
fieldStrmContentTemplateHint: Applies when the link mode is STRM. Default writes the video file absolute path

items.title: Title
items.ext: File extension (no dot). Subtitle template uses that subtitle's extension
items.raw_name: Source video filename. e.g. A/B.mp4 → B
items.raw_dir: Source parent directory name. e.g. A/B/C.mp4 → B
items.video_dir: Directory of the rendered video. Link and sidecar templates
items.video_name: Rendered video filename (no extension). Link and sidecar templates
items.video_relpath: Rendered video path relative to the library root. Link, sidecar, and STRM content templates
items.link_dir: Directory of the link; same as {video_dir} when the link template is unset
items.link_name: Rendered link filename (no extension); same as {video_name} when the link template is unset
items.raw_srt_name: Source subtitle filename. e.g. A/foo.zh.srt → foo.zh
